No JSON Schema type exists for it; shape checked by tsc, see x-uikit.slots.

x-uikit.intent: A sortable column's header button, toggling that column's sort state and showing its current direction.
typical_uses: The header render function of a sortable column in a DataTable

invariants.text: `column` must be the live `Column` instance a `ColumnDef`'s own `header` render function receives - toggling sort calls `column.toggleSorting()` directly, so this only makes sense mounted inside that render function, not constructed by hand elsewhere.

anti_patterns.dont: Use DataTableSortButton outside a column's header render function
anti_patterns.instead: For a plain action button with no column to sort, use Button directly

bad.title: Constructed outside any column header
bad.why: Outside a column's own `header` render function there is no live `Column` instance to pass - `column` is not something a consumer constructs by hand, it is handed in by TanStack Table's own render call.

column.typeText: Column<{ rowSelectionFeature: import("@tanstack/react-table/dist/index").TableFeature; rowSortingFeature: import("@tanstack/react-table/dist/index").TableFeature; rowPaginationFeature: import("@tanstack/react-table/dist/index").TableFeature; sortedRowModel: (table: import("@tanstack/react-table/dist/index").Table<any, any>) => () => import("@tanstack/react-table/dist/index").RowModel<any, any>; paginatedRowModel: (table: import("@tanstack/react-table/dist/index").Table<any, any>) => () => import("@tanstack/react-table/dist/index").RowModel<any, any>; }, TData, TValue>

dont_use_when.rule: A standalone action button with no column to sort

assumptions.claim: column is a live @tanstack/react-table Column instance, not data
assumptions.reason: `Column<DataTableFeatures, TData, TValue>` carries methods (`toggleSorting`, `getIsSorted`) and internal state, not a serializable shape - it stays annotation-only (a slot) in the compiled contract, the same way a function prop does.

assumptions.claim: TData and TValue are generic type parameters with no concrete shape
assumptions.reason: JSON Schema has no notion of a generic type parameter; both stay implicit in `column`'s slot type rather than typed properties.

assumptions.claim: DataTableSortButton composes the kit's own Button internally
assumptions.reason: It renders a `<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">` around its own label and a trailing sort-arrow icon - this is internal composition (JSX in DataTableSortButton's own render body), not a props-type heritage relationship, so the extractor reports it with no passthrough origin at all: DataTableSortButtonProps declares `column`/`children`/`className` itself and extends nothing.

assumptions.claim: its only real mount point is a column's header render function, which has no contract of its own
assumptions.reason: TanStack Table's `header: ({ column }) => ...` is a plain function prop on `ColumnDef`, not a kit component - there is no component_type_ref this contract could put in `composition.parent` for it, so the relationship is recorded here in prose instead.
